commodity: Mining explosives, initiating systems, ammonium nitrate, chemicals (water treatment, specialty), property services

commodity: Industrial gases (oxygen, nitrogen, argon, hydrogen, CO2), medical gases, welding products (Afrox)
operations: Air Liquide (Pty) Ltd HQ Alrode, Gauteng; operates 17 air separation units at Sasol Secunda (16 bought from Sasol 2021 for R8.5bn), ~750-800 staff, 20+ sites. Target 30-40% CO2 cut by 2031 (~1.2 Mt/yr). Afrox energy data not published.

commodity: Chlorine, caustic soda, hydrochloric acid, sodium hypochlorite, coagulants, hydrogen (chlor-alkali electrolysis)
operations: NCP Chlorchem (Pty) Ltd, sole shareholder BudVest (Pty) Ltd / Bud Group since Dec 2022; HQ and main electrolysis plant Chloorkop, Kempton Park (national key point; 224 ha solar evaporation salt farm); Cato Ridge KZN hypochlorite plant; Atlantis WC depot. Board: Chairman E Ashkar.
scale_note: Electricity is >50% of variable cost and ~90% of electricity is consumed as electrolysis feedstock, 24/7/365 (NCP v NERSA 2016 judgment). Behind-the-meter solar with Terra Firma: 1.1 MW pilot 2023, 10 MW operating, further 17.5 MW under construction for 27 MW total by end 2026 - 'one of the largest standalone behind-the-meter industrial installations in SA'. Also reported enrolled in virtual PPAs / wheeling with SolarAfrica (Energize). Revenue ~US$88m 2025 (third party). Employee count not published (site counters blank). Strong candidate for wheeled night-time/wind supply given continuous load.

operations: JSE-listed (OMN), HQ Fourways Sandton. WKN Windcurrent/PNE MoU (2023) for up to 100 MW wind+solar and 40-50 MW solar for green ammonia at Sasolburg; biomethane plant planned. No wheeled PPA announced yet - strong wheeling prospect.

commodity: Fuel retail and commercial fuels, lubricants blending, aviation/marine fuels, fuel storage terminals (Island View Durban, Alrode, etc.)
operations: Four separate companies: (1) Shell Downstream South Africa - 580 sites, 3.5bn litres; Shell SA Holdings agreed 7 Jul 2026 to sell 100% to ADNOC Distribution (~US$1bn, close 2027, Reatile Group + ESOP to take 28%); Shell brand stays under licence; Sapref refinery (Shell/bp) shut 2022 and sold to CEF May 2024. Engen Wentworth site is floated for a 1.8 GW gas-to-power plant (Vitol/ACWA/VTTI consortium) - a generation play, not an offtake. Rooftop solar at stations not quantified in official sources. Ownership churn (Shell to ADNOC 2027; Engen to Vivo 2024) makes long-dated PPAs unlikely near term.

commodity: Pipeline transport of refined petroleum products, crude and methane-rich gas
operations: Transnet Pipelines (TPL), division of Transnet SOC Ltd; HQ 202 Anton Lembede St, Durban (brief lists Johannesburg - that is Transnet group HQ). >3 800 km high-pressure network across KZN, Free State, Gauteng, Mpumalanga, North West; 40 sites (pump stations, booster/metering/delivery stations, terminals, workshops) supplied by Eskom and municipalities at 6.6-132 kV. scale_note: Electricity for pump stations is the dominant Scope 2 source; net-zero 2040 commitment. Nov 2025 RFI on etenders.gov.za for IPPs to supply WHEELED renewable energy to pump stations (on-site generation explicitly excluded; earlier RFI cited a 16 MW(h) target and cost pressure from the 13.87% Eskom increase); three grid-tied rooftop solar plants already at workshops; Sept 2026 RFP (TPL-2026-09-0613, ~R50m) for engineering of solar PV + BESS at 12 depot sites; Apr 2026 tender for an energy-transition strategy. Exact MWh consumption not published in the open sources. Highest-intent wheeling prospect in this list.
